最大限度减少USB信号线上的过孔和转角以减少信号反射和阻抗变化。
Minimize the number of vias and corners on the USB signal lines to reduce signal reflection and impedance variations.
USB信号线上尽量避免留有分支线，以免产生反射影响信号质量。
Avoid leaving stubs on the USB signal lines to prevent reflections that can degrade signal quality.
为防止信号辐射，USB信号线必须远离板边缘。
To prevent signal radiation, USB signal lines must be kept away from the edge of the board.
推荐使用15nH电感和1.8pF电容并联滤出USB线上的共模干扰，2.2pF用于滤出USB线上的差模干扰。

It is recommended to use a 15nH inductor and a 1.8pF capacitor in parallel to filter out common-mode interference on the USB lines. A 2.2pF capacitor should be used to filter out differential-mode interference on the USB lines.
RESERVED表示预留引脚，电路设计时需保持悬空，不能进行任何电气连接。
Pins marked as RESERVED are reserved for future use. When designing the circuit, these pins must be left floating and should not be connected to any electrical components or signals.
RSV表示功能暂未定义，建议做悬空处理； 输入输出方向定义的前提是模组作为主设备。

Pins marked as RSV are not yet defined in terms of functionality. It is recommended to leave these pins floating. The definition of input and output directions is based on the module acting as the master device.
USB_DM和USB_DP布线在关键信号层，按照差分走线要求控制，需要上下左右包地保护，差分阻抗控制在90Ω，各层走线保持阻抗连续；USB差分信号线必须越短越好，并且尽可能远离高速信号和其他同频信号。

The USB_DM and USB_DP traces should be routed on a critical signal layer and controlled according to differential routing requirements. They must be surrounded by ground planes on all sides (top, bottom, left, and right) for shielding. The differential impedances should be controlled at 90Ω, and impedance continuity should be maintained across all layers. The USB differential signal lines must be as short as possible and should be kept as far away as possible from high-speed signals and other signals of the same frequency.
本文档中“*”表示功能正在开发中，暂未开放。
In this document, "*" indicates features that are currently under development and not yet available.
模组包装无法承受高温烘烤，烘烤前请移除模组包装；短时间的烘烤，请参照IPC/JEDECJ-STD-033规范执行； 模组存储与烘烤相关的详细标准请参考《中移物联网智能模组部通信模组贴片应用指导》。

For detailed standards related to module storage and baking, please refer to the "China Mobile Internet of Things Intelligent Module Department Communication Module SMT Application Guide".
